title: Potsdam Declaration
summary: On 26 July 1945 the United States, Britain and China issued a proclamation from Potsdam setting terms for Japan's surrender. It called on Japan to proclaim unconditional surrender of all its armed forces, limited Japanese sovereignty to the four main islands, and warned of prompt and utter destruction. The Soviet Union did not sign.

uncertainty.note: Date of issue as given by the National Diet Library.
